title: Once the Pro lock is on, the AI assistant and the Get started list still send Starter gyms to Pro features
what: The Pro lock decides which pages a Starter gym can use. The AI assistant is told about Diet plans, Challenges, Shop and Branding for every gym, and can draft a diet plan (3 credits) whatever the gym pack. The Get started list asks every gym to add its logo and colours. Neither reads the gym pack, so a Starter gym would be sent to a locked page, or spend credits on a plan it cannot send. Not live today: the lock is off.
expected: With the lock on, the assistant leaves out the Pro pages and tasks for a Starter gym, and Get started skips the logo step or marks it as Pro.
how_often: every time, once the lock is switched on
fix_line: Hand the gym pack to the assistant and the Get started list, and leave out what the pack does not include

title: Editing a member or undoing an import does not update the door machines
what: The door machines are told about a member after a sale, renewal, freeze, cancel, moved start or archive. Changing a member (making them a pass member, removing the pass company, changing the name) and undoing an import also change who may come in, but the machines are not told. The nightly check only looks for a plan that started or ended overnight, so it never catches these: a member whose imported plan was undone can keep getting in. Not live today: the door machine service is not running.
expected: Any change that alters a member's right to come in, or the name on the machine, queues the machine update, as a sale does.
how_often: each pass change or undone import
fix_line: Tell the door machine job after a member edit and after an import or its undo

title: After adding a branch, no member can be checked in at the other branch until each one is ticked by hand
what: Checking in a member from another branch only works when that member has "Can train at every branch" ticked. The tick starts off for every member and can only be set one member at a time in their edit form; adding a branch does not ask about it. So on the day a gym opens its second branch, every existing member is refused. The desk is told the member's plan is for one branch only, but it is a tick on the member, not the plan. At Crispy Curves 0 of 3 members have it ticked.
expected: When a branch is added, the owner is asked whether existing members may train at every branch (all at once or per plan), and the refusal names the real reason.
who: owners and desk staff of gyms with 2 or more branches
fix_line: Offer a tick-all step when a branch is added, or let a plan cover every branch, and fix the refusal words

title: Member search on All branches finds nobody when a mobile number is pasted with +91 or typed in Hindi digits
what: The All branches search compares the digits typed with the member's saved mobile. A pasted or autofilled "+91 98290 12345" becomes 12 digits, which are not inside the 10 saved digits, so nothing is found. Hindi or other Indian keyboard digits are dropped, so they find nothing either. Every other mobile box uses the shared rule that removes +91 and reads those digits.
expected: The search cleans the number with the same rule as the mobile boxes, so +91, 0 in front, spaces and Indian digits all find the member.
how_often: each search with a pasted number
fix_line: Run the search digits through the shared mobile rule before comparing
